title: Peter Thiel and George Gilder debate on "The Prospects for Technology and Economic Growth"
summary: A 2012 debate between Peter Thiel and George Gilder on whether technological progress and economic growth are accelerating or decelerating, moderated by William Davidow.
why: Cited for Thiel's technological stagnation thesis, especially his argument that energy costs offset IT productivity gains.

quote.text: if you have an extra hour, its well worth it to listen to Thiel in this more recent debate
